description: Sum an order of (name, price, quantity) lines into a final price. Each line is price times quantity; a line whose quantity exceeds 10 takes a 10 percent per-line discount. After summing the lines, an order whose running total exceeds 1000 takes a further 5 percent discount, and the result is rounded to two decimals. Pure and deterministic. Integer-only orders return an int and discounted orders return a float; the golden captures the reference's actual mixed int/float outputs verbatim. The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain including the empty order and both discount boundaries (quantity 10 vs 11, total exactly 1000 vs just over).
constraints: deterministic, pure, no I/O, no randomness, no global state
